# rwx_directory (Data Source)

Looks up an existing connected directory by exact name or local RWX ID. Connect the directory in the RWX UI first. Requires `org:access`. Directory rosters and mappings are not managed by this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rwx_directory" "by_name" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

data "rwx_directory" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The stable local RWX directory ID, not the external identity-provider ID. Specify exactly one of id or name.
- `name` (String) The exact, case-sensitive directory name. Names must match a single directory; use id when names are ambiguous. Specify exactly one of id or name.
